spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS time,
  building,
  room,
  AVG(temperature) AS "Temperature"
FROM room_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND building IN (${building:sqlstring})
  AND room IN (${room:sqlstring})
GROUP BY date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time), building, room
ORDER BY time ASC, building ASC, room ASC;

SELECT
  date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS time,
  building,
  room,
  MAX(busy_level) AS "Busy level"
FROM room_telemetry
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND building IN (${building:sqlstring})
  AND room IN (${room:sqlstring})
GROUP BY date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time), building, room
ORDER BY time ASC, building ASC, room ASC;

  date_bin(INTERVAL '10 seconds', time) AS time,
